# cfgkit

> Typed configuration from layered sources for Go — compiled-in defaults, provenance, secret masking, and .env.example generation.

cfgkit is open source (ubgo/cfgkit). Everything runs locally; nothing is sent to the cloud.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/ubgo/cfgkit/blob/main/README.md): overview, install, usage
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/ubgo/cfgkit/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/ubgo/cfgkit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute

## Install
- Homebrew: `brew install ubgo/cfgkit` (see README for the tap)
- Releases: https://github.com/ubgo/cfgkit/releases

## Links
- Repository: https://github.com/ubgo/cfgkit
- Homepage: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ubgo/cfgkit
